zh.title: 澳洲航空阿德雷德產品創新中心啟用
zh.summary: 澳洲航空啟用阿德雷德產品創新中心；首批50名員工進駐
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）已於南澳阿德雷德啟用新的產品創新中心（Product Innovation Center），將其技術產品開發團隊集中於同一地點，加速數位工具與人工智慧驅動的客戶體驗開發。
南澳州長Peter Malinauskas與澳洲航空集團技術長Rachel Yangoyan共同出席啟用儀式。中心位於阿德雷德市中心，將作為產品經理、數位體驗設計師、軟體工程師及資料與人工智慧專家的據點。
首批50名員工已開始在新辦公室工作，澳洲航空正招聘另外40個職缺，並預計三年內中心將擴充至超過400個數位與科技職位。
澳洲航空另與阿德雷德大學合作建立畢業生招募管道，首批申請人數達數百人，畢業生預計於2027年2月開始工作。

en.title: Qantas opens Product Innovation Center in Adelaide, plans 400-plus tech roles
en.summary: Qantas opens Adelaide Product Innovation Center; first 50 staff start, 400-plus roles planned
body: Qantas has opened a new Product Innovation Center in Adelaide, South Australia, bringing together the airline's technology product development teams in one location as it accelerates in-house development of digital tools and AI-driven customer experiences.
South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas joined Qantas Group Chief Technology, AI and Transformation Officer Rachel Yangoyan at the official opening of the center, located in the Adelaide CBD.

The first 50 employees have begun working at the new premises, and Qantas is recruiting for an additional 40 roles, O. For Qantas expects to grow the center to more than 400 digital and technology positions over the next three years, with support from the South Australian Government.
Qantas is also partnering with Adelaide University to create graduate recruitment pathways directly into the center, with graduates expected to start in February 2027.
